AnyPS5-ARM 0.2.41 brings **PS1 games into the Mac launcher's own window**, through the signed PS1 emulator host that **Settings › Emulators can now download** (anyps5-retro-host 1.1.0 with SwanStation, by B-Howell), with **save states**, an **Internal resolution** choice and the **PS menu** that AnyPS5 Desktop has (B-Howell's Desktop work, ported to the Mac). **A game now starts from its cover** (designed by Lenny4250gh for AnyPS5 Desktop), and **quitting the launcher while a game plays closes the game first** and gives it time to save. **AnyPS5 Desktop 0.1.27** brings save states and Internal resolution to PS1 games on Windows and Linux. releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.13
releases.body:
# WeHavePhones 0.0.13

This alpha update adds a floating game window and automatic Android keyboard support. It also reduces background CPU use and fixes several touch and graphics issues.

Install over your existing version to keep your data.

## What's new

- **Floating game window** is on by default. When you switch apps, the game can keep playing in Android's picture-in-picture window, capped at 20 FPS. Tap the window and use its expand button to return to full screen. You can turn it off in Settings. The background setting is now called **Keep running in background**.
- The Android keyboard opens when a WoW text field gains focus and closes when you finish typing. It stays closed while a hardware keyboard is connected.
- The game surface requests 60 Hz while you play, including during touch input, to reduce display power use on high-refresh-rate phones. WeHavePhones also cleans up leftover Wine processes shortly after a session ends.
- **Disable WoW voice chat** is on by default to reduce background CPU use. Turn it off in Settings if you use WoW's built-in voice chat.

## Touch controls

releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.12
releases.body:
# WeHavePhones 0.0.12

An alpha update fixing a controller regression in 0.0.11.

Install over your existing version to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.**

## Touch controls

- The action wheel is now enabled by default on wide screens. Turn off **Menu → Touch controls → Action wheel** to use standard action bars. Existing saved choices are preserved.

## Fixes

- Moving the left stick on a controller no longer presses the D-pad too, so D-pad bindings in WoW only fire from the D-pad. This fixes a regression in 0.0.11 (#39).

## Validation

- All 14 host suites, the E2E runner self-test, ShellCheck, Ruff and Android Lint passed.
- Forever 1.60.1.70938 passed in the signed 0.0.12 RC on a Galaxy S23+. Controller UI persisted after an in-game exit and relaunch. World entry and jumping passed with default controls.
- Touch controls passed world entry, jumping, stick movement and camera turning. The wheel passed swipes in both directions, hub taps and casting Healing Touch from an existing slot.
- Settings were restored and controller UI returned after the touch tests. No new Android crash entries appeared.

releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.11
releases.body:
An alpha update with redesigned touch controls, lower graphics memory use and controller fixes.

Install over 0.0.10 to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.** Setup → App update can install the published release for you.

## Major change to touch controls

The new touch action wheels have four rings of nine slots using WoW's Action Bars 6 to 8. Swipe around the hub or tap it to change rings, tap a slot to use it, and hold a slot to change it.

**Existing touch-control users may need to re-add their spells and items to the new wheels.**

![Redesigned touch controls with the action wheel](https://github.com/ashmerra/wehavephones/releases/download/v0.0.11/WeHavePhones-0.0.11-touch-controls.png)

## What's new

- Added 75%, 90% and 110% touch interface sizes. The movement stick, toolbar and other native touch controls now resize with the interface, at a gentler rate to keep them easy to tap.

releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.10
releases.body:
An alpha update focused on touch controls, launch reliability and addon apps.

Install over 0.0.9 to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.** Setup → App update can install the published release for you.

## Changes

- Touch chat starts compact when you enter the world and expands when you use it. Its controls stay clear of page keys and the keyboard.
- The touch quest tracker sits below the player frame. Play-mode drags turn the character, and the current touch mode is easier to see.
- Fixed taps missing their target when the Android keyboard pans the game screen.
- Fixed an exited WoW process blocking the next launch.
- Disabled Wine audio codec drivers that delayed Battle.net startup. Previous controlled S23 measurements reached the Play button about six seconds sooner.
- Fixed WowUp hanging at its logo with a backport of Wine's large-message fix. Removed the obsolete WowUp app patch.
- Added automated game and addon app checks for contributors.

## Testing and limitations

- All 13 host check suites, the E2E runner self-test, ShellCheck, Ruff and Android Lint passed.

releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.9
releases.body:
An alpha update focused on Forever touch controls, launch frame pacing and diagnostics.

Install over 0.0.8 to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.** Setup → App update can install it for you.

## What's new

- Battle.net and the launch screens now run at 30 FPS to reduce rendering work before WoW starts. The cap lifts automatically when WoW starts, so gameplay is unaffected.
- Diagnostics now includes Android's recorded reasons for recent app exits, helping identify low-memory closures and crashes. Available on Android 11 and later.
- Added experimental Turnip Gen8 V38 as a manual graphics driver choice on Adreno 7xx phones.

## Touch control fixes

- Forever now receives the touch layout, with chat, player frames and hotbars positioned clear of the touch buttons.
- Forever's controller and gamepad interface now turn off when launching with touch controls. Turning touch controls off restores your previous controller settings on the next launch.
- Fixed "Interface action failed because of an AddOn" errors caused by the Forever touch layout during combat.
- Fixed Forever's hidden quest tracker and quests disappearing when selecting a target.

releases.name: v0.5.13: NVN optimizations, FSR 1.0, controller rumble & Android 10 fix
releases.body:
## Persona 5 Royal Android Recomp v0.5.13

### Español
- **Optimizaciones universales NVN/Android y FSR 1.0 (PR #263):** Reducción de permutaciones de pipeline con EDS1-3, precompilación de shaders en segundo plano, pooling de staging/spill buffers, aislamiento en núcleos grandes y caché de vistas `HandleSlot` entre shaders.
- **Nuevas opciones en el Launcher (PR #264):** Añadidos toggles para escalado **FSR 1.0 (`NX_FSR`)** y **sombras bajas para Mali (`NX_MALI_LOW_SHADOWS`)**.
- **Vibración en mando físico y dispositivo (PR #252):** Soporte de rumble/vibración en Android.
- **Fix Android 10 (API 29) (#258):** Guard para `InsetsController` en dispositivos por debajo de Android 11 con fallback seguro a modo inmersivo clásico.
- **Diagonales en mando físico (#255) y swapchain FSR:** Zona muerta radial 2D para alcanzar el 100% en diagonales y resolución nativa de swapchain preservada cuando `NX_FSR=1`.

---

### English
- **Universal NVN/Android optimizations & single-pass FSR 1.0 (PR #263):** EDS1-3 pipeline permutation reduction, background shader prewarm, staging spill buffer pooling, big-core thread isolation, and cross-shader `HandleSlot` view caching.

releases.name: v0.5.12: Hide controls option, Play crash hotfix & GPU hang fixes
releases.body:
## Persona 5 Royal Android Recomp v0.5.12

### Español
- **Ocultar controles en pantalla:** Se añadió la opción en el Launcher (`NX_TOUCH_HIDE`) para ocultar los controles visuales. Los controles siguen 100% activos y funcionales al tocar la pantalla, ideal para quienes prefieren la pantalla limpia o juegan con memoria muscular.
- **Corrección de cierre inmediato al iniciar (Play crash):** Se protegió el acceso a JNI y verificación de permisos de almacenamiento en `android_main` para dispositivos cargando directo por NSP/FD (POCO X7 Pro, POCO F6, etc.).
- **Solución al congelamiento en "Preparing game":** Se limitaron los hilos del compilador de shaders a un máximo de 4 durante la importación, solucionando bloqueos indefinidos en procesadores MediaTek Dimensity 8350.
- **Corrección de cuelgues de GPU (GPU Hangs):** Se deshabilitaron las divisiones de renderpass a mitad de pase (`NX_CHUNK_IN_PASS=0`) por defecto en GPUs TBDR (Adreno 830 / Mali).
- **Corrección de texto en mensajes (IM / SNS Chat):** Se corrigió el renderizado del texto en las opciones de respuesta del chat del teléfono móvil (PR #251).

releases.body:
## Persona 5 Royal Android v0.5.11

### Fixes & Improvements / Correcciones y mejoras
- **Audio resume on sleep/lock screen (Fixes #238):**
  Automatically recreates the AAudio stream when disconnected, restoring game sound upon waking or unlocking the phone.
  *Se re-crea automáticamente el flujo de audio de AAudio al desconectarse, restaurando el sonido del juego al desbloquear o reanudar el teléfono.*
- **UI stripes and color banding on tile-based GPUs (Fixes #243):**
  Fixed bound pipeline and dynamic state cache invalidation on render pass end, preventing dull colors and white stripes in menus and dialogue on Adreno, Mali, and PowerVR.
  *Se corrigió la invalidación del estado dinámico y pipelines al finalizar un pase de renderizado, solucionando colores apagados y franjas blancas en la interfaz.*
- **Qualcomm Snapdragon cutscene video alignment (PR #245):**
  Applied proper row alignment independently of stride for Qualcomm hardware decoders, fixing green and distorted lines during opening cutscenes.
  *Alineación de filas independiente de stride para decodificadores Qualcomm, eliminando líneas verdes y distorsiones en cinemáticas.*
- **PowerVR title screen stability:**

releases.name: v0.5.10: PowerVR title screen crash fixed
releases.body:
## Persona 5 Royal Android v0.5.10

### Fixes & Improvements / Correcciones y mejoras
- **PowerVR crash at the title screen fixed:** on PowerVR GPUs (for example the moto g54) the game closed right after the opening movie, when the title screen appeared. It now reaches the title and keeps going.
  **Arreglado el cierre en la pantalla de título en PowerVR:** en GPUs PowerVR (por ejemplo el moto g54) el juego se cerraba justo después del vídeo de la intro, al aparecer la pantalla de título. Ahora llega al título y sigue.

### Known issue / Problema conocido
- On some PowerVR phones the picture may hold for a few seconds at that point while the sound keeps playing; then the game continues.
  En algunos móviles PowerVR la imagen puede quedarse quieta unos segundos en ese punto mientras el sonido sigue; después el juego continúa.

Install over the previous version; your saves and data stay. / Instálalo encima de la versión anterior; tus partidas y datos se mantienen.

releases.name: v0.5.9: fixed movie stripes and PowerVR crash
releases.body:
## Persona 5 Royal Android v0.5.9

### Fixes & Improvements / Correcciones y mejoras
- **Movies without diagonal stripes:** since v0.5.7 the videos and some cutscenes showed diagonal colour stripes on many phones (Mali, Exynos, MediaTek and some Snapdragon). The port misread how the phone's video decoder lays out each frame; it now reads it correctly.
  **Vídeos sin rayas diagonales:** desde la v0.5.7 los vídeos y algunas cinemáticas salían con rayas diagonales de colores en muchos móviles (Mali, Exynos, MediaTek y algunos Snapdragon). El port leía mal cómo el decodificador de vídeo del móvil organiza cada imagen; ahora lo lee bien.
- **PowerVR crash at start fixed:** on PowerVR GPUs (for example the moto g54) the game closed a few seconds after opening, on the loading icon. It now starts and plays normally.
  **Arreglado el cierre al iniciar en PowerVR:** en GPUs PowerVR (por ejemplo el moto g54) el juego se cerraba a los pocos segundos de abrirlo, en el icono de carga. Ahora arranca y se juega con normalidad.

Install over the previous version; your saves and data stay. / Instálalo encima de la versión anterior; tus partidas y datos se mantienen.

releases.body:
Changes since the latest beta release:
- Fixed two UI issues (#843, #846)
- Fixed a bug in the CBM file system implementation (#853)
- Fixed a bug in the drive idle logic (#854)
- Fixed three drive-related VICE tests (#668, #674, #675)

Core and API

* Public API: The API now has as new shape. There are async counterparts (…Async) for state-changing calls, set is now setAsync, there is a new MemoryDebugger API, more getters, and suspend/resume coverage across the API.
* Threading: The command queue and message queue are now std::deque-based. Messages can carry exceptions. AudioPort is thread-safe. Cmd::CALL, TRACK_ON and TRACK_OFF are new.
* Messages: Msg::CONFIG is sent for every option change. ROM_LOADED, RSH_DONE and CONFIG_ERROR are new.
* RetroShell: It has the new architecture from vAmiga, with multiple shells and a single console per shell.
* Workspaces: A screenshot is now saved inside saveWorkspace().
* X-Ray: GPU X-Ray support is added, with a new XRAY_COMPOSITOR option.
* Shared libraries: utlib and rvlib were merged with the versions shared with vAmiga and Silicium.
* Cleanup: Header, include and namespace cleanups, plus removal of orphaned files.

Fixes

* Drive::isIdle() is fixed (#854).

This maintenance release primarily addresses issue #851, which prevented the app from running on the upcoming macOS 27 Golden Gate. It also includes internal code changes required to make the core compatible with the architecture of the upcoming Silicium emulator.
Removing beta status, as no significant bugs have been reported for some time.

## Refactoring

This beta release introduces substantial changes to the underlying code base. As part of the development of the RetroVault app, a new **RetroVault** library has been created. This library is now responsible for managing:

- File systems  
- Devices  
- All supported image formats  

RetroVault is designed as a standalone library and is also used in the latest version of vAmiga for the same purpose.

In addition, the new **utlib** library has been introduced. All utility functions previously embedded in vAmiga and VirtualC64 have been refactored into this more powerful shared library. This makes it easier for me to share common functionality among the different emulators. 

## Enhancements

- The disassembler now supports symbol files (#837)

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed a crash in the file system importer when importing excessively large folders (#841)  
- Fixed a bug in the VIC inspector that prevented selecting individual sprites in Tahoe (#840)

releases.body:
This is the sixth preview release of version 1.0 of DOSBox Pure.

A smaller update with additions and fixes. Again, please test this release and provide feedback as we work towards a release we can call 1.0. Feedback is welcome here on GitHub as well as on [Discord](https://discord.gg/swhZC8xFJw).

## New Features

### Support for Dynamic VHD Disk Images (#694)
Installing an operating system will also automatically create dynamic VHD files from now on (which initially is just a few megabytes and grows as needed)

### Volume Settings (93cf48b)
Volume settings were added to the core options for the various DOS devices (Sound Blaster, Adlib, MIDI, etc.)]

### Handle shut down requests in Windows 9x (#738)
Minimal implementation of APM (Advanced Power Management) BIOS functionality just to handle the power off request by Windows 9x. This will allow to automatically go back to the menu or exit the core/emulator when the emulated Windows is shut down.

## Minor Additions
- Allow mounting of ZIP files via IMGMOUNT command (with `IMGMOUNT X: file.zip -t zip`) (04a1b95)
- Support a custom extended M3U format tag to overlay the multiple contents (i.e. load multiple ZIP files as C:) (#731)

# 0.60.1 is out

There was a bug in the AppImage Updater Code. To fix this i have to revert to the old AppImage build and wait several weeks to ensure a smooth update process.

# 0.60.0 is out 🎉

This release is special for me. I build emuze with web technologies because that’s where I have the most experience, and I’m really proud of what I’ve achieved over the years. I’ve always wanted to help out in this wonderful emulation community, but aside from testing, I couldn’t do much to help with the emulators I love because I struggled with C++ code, which most emulators are written in. But sometimes you feel forced to try and try again. Since v0.59.0, I’ve successfully added a [change to RMG](https://github.com/Rosalie241/RMG/pull/518) to use the SDL GUID to identify a gamepad more reliably, and I forked Mednafen with [mednafen-sdl3](https://github.com/bmsuseluda/mednafen-sdl3) to greatly expand gamepad support. Those changes are just baby steps in the grand scheme of things, but they felt great, and I hope I can build on them in the future.

# 0.59.2 is out 🎉

This release is mostly preparation work to greatly reduce the file size of the AppImage with release 0.60.0.
Besides this fuse2 is not necessary anymore and Metainfos for AppImage Managers e.g. AM are included.

Please let me know what you think of it in the [emuze discord](https://discord.gg/tCzK7kc6Y4).

## 💥 Features
- added AppImage Metainfos
- AppImage works without fuse2
- Preparation work to greatly reduce the file size of the AppImage with release 0.60.0

# 0.59.0 is out 🎉

As you might now i love the simplicity of console gaming. You start the game and it just works. With emulation more often then not you have to provide more then just the game. You need things like a BIOS file, firmware or key files. I wanted to assist with this for a long time. With this release you can choose a folder where you can put your BIOS files and emuze will pick them up and configure the Emulators. Of course emuze will tell you if a required file is missing. On top of this emuze comes bundled with open source BIOS implementations for PlayStation, Game Boy Advance and NEO GEO. Of course you can use official BIOS files instead if you need by putting them in the BIOS folder. Sadly i was not able to achieve the same result for more complicated systems like PlayStation 3, WiiU and Switch. These systems require a installation of a firmware. # Lumen Emu 0.1.0 build 5 for iOS and iPadOS

This preview targets ARM64 iPhones and iPads running iOS or iPadOS 17.4 or later. The IPA is intended for sideloading and local signing with AltStore Classic. Both the PS4 and PS5 cores require JIT. Installing this build and enabling JIT through AltStore Classic still need to be verified on a physical iPhone.

## Installation and JIT setup

1. [Install the IPA with AltStore Classic](https://github.com/gs-soft-it/lumen-emu/blob/main/README.md#install-the-ipa-with-altstore-classic)
2. [Enable JIT on iPhone](https://github.com/gs-soft-it/lumen-emu/blob/main/README.md#enable-jit-on-iphone)

## Core changes

- The PS4 core uses FFmpeg for AAC decoding and Mbed TLS 3.6.7 for HTTPS. Apple Security verifies certificate trust and hostnames.
- The PS5 core uses the project's SPIR-V transformations for its native Metal renderer on iOS.
- The on-device JIT component is built from StikJIT 2.0.1 and `idevice` 0.1.68 using RustCrypto and a pinned `Cargo.lock`. The separate JIT extension uses AGPLv3. Dependency provenance and license notices are in the source archive and in `Legal/stikjit` inside the IPA.

## Testing and compatibility

# PS5PCEM 0.3.3

Changes since **0.3.2**: three additional titles reach in-game scenes,
Subnautica: Below Zero can create and restore a world, GTA III reaches driving,
Little Nightmares reaches character control and save/reload, and Big Helmet
Heroes advances into its tutorial. This release also includes the accumulated
renderer, synchronization, memory, shader-cache and package-extraction work
from September 25 through October 5, 2026.

PS5PCEM remains experimental. The measurements below are dated development
checks included in this release's source history, not fresh benchmarks of every
title on the final packaged executable. All reported FPS comes from the
development host, a Ryzen 7 7700 / GeForce RTX 3070 Ti 8 GiB. A visible scene or
working save does not establish a complete playthrough.

releases.name: PS5PCEM 0.3.2
releases.body:
# PS5PCEM 0.3.2

Changes since **0.3.1-beta.1**: more confirmed playable titles, Quake II rendering
fixes, working movie audio and later 3D scenes in Ghost of Yōtei, a corrected and
faster Tetris interface, parallel shader compilation and command preparation,
and a native package extractor included with the launcher.

PS5PCEM remains an experimental emulator. Compatibility claims below distinguish
maintainer-confirmed playthroughs from menus, captured scenes, and measured
performance on the development machine.

## Game compatibility

- **Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: Rita's Rewind** is now **playable and
  completable**, confirmed by the maintainer on September 24, 2026. The latest
  capture shows the Red Ranger in the Command Center training stage with the
  HUD, objectives, and controller prompts. The existing narrowly matched CRT
  scaling fallback remains necessary on the development host.
- **Quake II** reaches gameplay and is recorded as **playable and completable**
  following the maintainer's September 16 confirmation. Fixes cover startup
  imports and directory listings, deferred G-buffer writes, depth comparison

sensor input, alongside Vulkan performance, graphics, audio and save fixes.

The CPU baseline remains **x86-64-v3 (AVX2/BMI2/FMA)**. Vulkan remains the

releases.body:
**Beta 0.3.4.** Acaba a **queda de fps depois de fechar o inventário** ([#53](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/53), [#24](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/24)) e melhora a **geração de quadros (LSFG)**: importar o `Lossless.dll`, funcionar em mais GPUs Mali e pedir à tela a taxa de atualização que os quadros gerados precisam.

> **Nenhum arquivo do jogo vem junto.** Você precisa do seu próprio dump de *Tears of the Kingdom* com a atualização **1.4.3** aplicada (`exefs` e `romfs`, ou o `romfs` como um único `romfs.bin`).

Atualiza por cima das versões anteriores sem apagar os saves. **Não desinstale o app antes**: isso apaga os saves.

## O que mudou

- **Queda depois do menu ([#53](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/53), [#24](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/24)):**
  - A queda de 12-14 s depois de fechar o inventário, de escolher uma arma ou de salvar não era o clock da GPU, como eu tinha dito.
  - O app desligava o "sync lag" por ~10 s sempre que o jogo saía do mundo, para proteger os carregamentos. Só que ele não distinguia um menu de uma tela de carregamento, e nesses segundos a CPU ficava esperando a GPU.

releases.name: TOTKDroid 0.3.3 (beta): FSR 1 e FXAA mais leves
releases.body:
**Beta 0.3.3.** O **FSR 1** e o **FXAA** ficaram mais leves para a GPU, com a mesma imagem.

> **Nenhum arquivo do jogo vem junto.** Você precisa do seu próprio dump de *Tears of the Kingdom* com a atualização **1.4.3** aplicada (`exefs` e `romfs`, ou o `romfs` como um único `romfs.bin`).

Atualiza por cima das versões anteriores sem apagar os saves. **Não desinstale o app antes**: isso apaga os saves.

## O que mudou

- **FSR 1 (EASU) na metade do tempo:**
  - A análise de borda roda uma vez por pixel, em vez de quatro.
  - Onde não há borda, o pixel sai direto da interpolação bilinear.
  - As contas de cor usam meia precisão, que vira fp16 onde o driver aceita.
  - No POCO F7 Ultra (Adreno 830), o upscale de 1280x717 para 1920x1080 caiu de 1,00 para 0,50 ms por quadro. Não vi diferença nas bordas lado a lado.
  - Ideias do artigo "Optimizing FSR", de atyuwen, reescritas a partir do FSR 1 original.
- **FXAA ~18% mais leve:**
  - Usa meia precisão e o limiar padrão do FXAA 3.11, em vez do "ultra".
  - A busca da borda é mais curta: 5 passos em vez de 10.
  - No POCO caiu de 0,51-0,59 para 0,43-0,44 ms por quadro, sem diferença de serrilhado visível.

**Beta 0.3.2.** Corrige dois problemas da 0.3.1: os **quadrados magenta com a Economia de RAM ligada** ([#57](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/57)) e a **queda para 2-3 fps no mundo aberto em algumas Mali** (Dimensity 9500, [#41](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/41)).

Atualiza por cima das versões anteriores sem apagar os saves. **Não desinstale o app antes**: isso apaga os saves.

## O que mudou

- **Quadrados magenta com a Economia de RAM ([#57](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/57)):**
  - A 0.3.1 devolvia ao sistema a memória de cada textura depois de enviá-la à GPU, o que deixava zeros no lugar. O TOTK reaproveita essa memória para criar texturas novas, que então eram enviadas zeradas e apareciam magenta.
  - Isso agora fica desligado. A Economia de RAM continua usando texturas menores e menos memória de cópia.

network programs in openMSX.

MSX device support:
- fixed Yamanooto SCC register visibility

releases.name: openMSX 21.0
releases.body:
openMSX 21.0 has many improvements on the new GUI introduced in openMSX 20.0 (especially the debugger) and several other smaller features. It also introduces the "setups" concept, which enables you to define an MSX setup (e.g. a Philips VG 8020 with an external disk drive and a joystick, data recorder and printer connected). These can be created, loaded, and automatically started. They can also be saved automatically when you exit.

Furthermore, flash chip emulation has become a lot more accurate, thanks to Laurens Holst.

releases.name: openMSX 20.0
releases.body:
openMSX 20.0—Autumn Spring—is a major release, in which we introduce the new Graphical User Interface, replacing the OSD menu. A faster and more powerful debugger is now included in openMSX itself. Configuration for MSX joystick/JoyMega has been improved drastically using the new GUI. If you still want to use Catapult, you can use the Catapult release that came with openMSX 19.0. Please [read the release notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openMSX/openMSX/RELEASE_20_0/doc/release-notes.txt) for details of the openMSX changes.

As always, special thanks to all the contributors of this release who are not in the core team! Keep these pull requests coming!

Please note that as of now, a system with OpenGL 2 support is required to run openMSX.

releases.name: openMSX 19.1
releases.body:
openMSX 19.1—Reflection—is a bug fix release for openMSX 19.0, as we found some rather nasty issues after releasing, mostly that LaserDisc support was broken. No new Catapult will be released, as it has no changes.  Please [read the release notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openMSX/openMSX/RELEASE_19_1/doc/release-notes.txt) for details of the openMSX changes.

Thanks for those who gave us the feedback so that we found out about these issues.

Please note that this will be the last openMSX release that supports systems without OpenGL 2 or higher.

releases.body:
## Security: Steam token redaction in logs

GameHub Lite 5.1.8 fixes a logging issue where Steam authentication-related values could appear in diagnostic logs. 
In some cases, logs could include fields such as `steamToken`, `refreshToken`, or `accessToken` from Steam login/launch flows.

**Publicly posted logs containing these fields should be deleted or redacted.**

### IMPORTANT

This should go without saying but If you find any security issues, please reach out **PRIVATELY**.

# GameHub Lite v5.1.6

This release fixes an actual app-side launch issue, and yes, also exists because apparently backend fixes do not count unless there is a fresh APK attached to a GitHub release.

The main app fix is for devices where GameHub would silently refuse to launch games when the `getUnknownDevices` / `startType` API path returned a `404`. Instead of failing closed and doing absolutely nothing, the app now falls back like it already did for the no-internet path.

Confirmed affected and fixed:

- AYANEO Pocket FIT
- Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 / Adreno 750
- Android 14

### Backend changes

More work happened in [gamehub-lite-api](https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite-api), because that is where a lot of compatibility and component delivery work lives now.

Backend changes since the `v5.1.5` release include:

- Updated simulator response timestamps so stale responses get refreshed.
- Added release asset verification and MD5 checks for GitHub release assets.
- Updated component manifests, timestamps, deprecated component removal, and total counts.
- Cleaned up SteamAgent2 manifest naming.
- Removed drivers that were already added in the latest GameHub manifest.

releases.body:
This release adds a bundled driver for Snapdragon 8 Elite, brings back the audio presets that were missing from 0.6.0, fixes DLC imports and GPU hangs, lets each touch control be resized, and redesigns the launcher.

## Graphics

- **Adreno 8xx driver for Snapdragon 8 Elite.** A source-built Mesa 26.3 Turnip with a fix for the newer Qualcomm gralloc, which otherwise leaves the whole image garbled on Adreno 830. Auto selects it on SM8750 devices unless an imported driver is chosen, and it always renders with `TU_DEBUG=sysmem,nobin`. On Adreno 830 it measured about 12 ms of GPU time per frame at 100% resolution, compared with about 26 ms on the stock driver. Other Adreno 8xx GPUs can select it manually; it has only been validated on Adreno 830.
- **High refresh rate displays.** The game requests the display's fastest mode and passes the FPS option to Android, so FPS settings above 60 are no longer capped at 60 by vsync on 120 Hz phones.

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.6.0
releases.body:
- Fixed DLC imports after the base game is installed, including DLC-only ZIPs/folders and ZIPs left in to_install by older builds (issue #162). Packs are hash-checked in a temporary tree before replacement; previous packs can be recovered after an interrupted replacement.
- Accepted HMM JSON schemas with trailing commas, comments and a UTF-8 BOM; schema errors no longer dump the complete file (issue #93).
- Added a persisted game-storage choice for internal memory, app folders and Android/media folders on mounted volumes, including SD cards. Optional verified copying keeps the original game, mods, settings and saves (issue #90).
- Added missing translations in English, Russian, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese and Portuguese, including mod settings, updates, storage selection and localized file/installer errors.
- Fixed overlapping guest memory copies with `memmove`, addressing the ring crash and broken collision triggers (PR #158 fix by [puopg (Michael Chen)](https://github.com/puopg)).
- Removed the earlier small-block quarantine and collision repair workarounds alongside that fix (PR #158).

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.5.3
releases.body:
small update

### Vulkan driver profiles

- Added **Adreno 8xx Experimental (sysmem+flushall)** as a separate, non-default launcher choice.
- The new profile uses the bundled whitebelyash Mesa 26.2 gen8-capable driver and forces the exact `TU_DEBUG=sysmem,flushall` workaround for artifact-prone Adreno 8xx devices.

### Android audio presets

- Added an experimental **POCO F8 Ultra (low latency)** preset. It reduces the internal FIFO cushion from 16 to 8 guest audio frames (about 85 ms to 43 ms) and requests AAudio's exclusive low-latency path to avoid HyperOS selecting an approximately 80 ms shared hardware burst.

releases.name: v2.3 – Faster games, NFL Fever 2004 fix, Linux build, Performance and compatibility release: CPU boost, GPU boost, per-game settings with automatic safe mode, a fix that lets NFL Fever 2004 run, and a first Linux build
releases.body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> Experimental, unofficial fork of xemu for trying out UI improvements. Not supported by the xemu project: please don't ask about it in xemu's Discord or GitHub.
What's new in v2.3
This release is about speed and game compatibility. The emulation changes are listed here so you know what touches the game itself.
CPU boost and GPU boost (Settings > General > Performance). CPU boost runs the game's SSE math on your PC's processor and trims work in the CPU emulation. GPU boost turns on faster paths in the graphics code, such as skipping textures a shader never reads. Turn either off if a game misbehaves. The ideas and some of the code come from Tovarichtch's xemu fork (branch `perf-experimental`).
Per-game settings and safe mode. Each game can have its own CPU boost, GPU boost and shader seeding, used the next time it starts (Settings > General > Performance > This game). If xemu closes unexpectedly while a boost was on, that game starts in safe mode the next time, with the boosts off, and tells you. "Leave safe mode" is in the same place.

Close the game and back up the complete save set (your saves folder), not only the GDD. Keep the GDD, its recovery and snapshot directories, and the `course-*` files together.
Tracks that use the new wind or CPU aggression settings save a newer settings block that 1.2.x cannot read. Tracks that do not use them stay readable by older builds. Keep your backup if you might go back to 1.2.x.

The Windows x64, Linux x64 and Linux arm64 downloads now include the Companion, a separate desktop program in the `companion` folder inside your G-Diffuser folder. It builds the files G-Diffuser loads and checks every input before it builds. It never edits your settings, saves or stores.

releases.name: G-Diffuser 1.2.3 - Course Editor Hotfix
releases.body:
## Fixes
- Correct complete-course snapshot content binding so metadata-only edits do not reuse an incompatible retained snapshot.
- Handle terminal disk-write refusals without trapping Course Edit in its save wait loop.
- Fix the host editor's remaining 64-node admission ceiling. The supported total remains 127 nodes, including forks.
- Restore Content Library layout previews for supported tracks above 64 nodes.
- Adapt native load, overwrite, and delete confirmations to long filenames while keeping normal-size text and the Yes/No controls in place.
- Size the Course Edit information panel dynamically to fit the track title, length, and node count.

## Save compatibility — read before updating
Close the game and back up the complete installation save/state set before updating, not only the cartridge `.sav` file.

This release writes version-2 `.gcs` snapshots and still reads version 1. Older builds cannot read version-2 snapshots or packages that contain them. Before downgrading, restore the complete matching pre-upgrade save/state backup. Keeping old snapshots alone is not sufficient.

releases.name: G-Diffuser 1.2.2 - Save and Import Hotfix

## G-Diffuser 1.2.2 - Save and Import Hotfix

- Fix disk-write ownership checks that could prevent Course Edit saves from completing and cause track imports to fail with MFS error 244.
- Preserve snapshot validation, rollback, and recovery protections during save and import operations.
- Add regression coverage using the production disk-write helper, including write failures and rollback.

Back up your installation's save and course-state files before updating. This hotfix does not change the course snapshot format.

releases.name: NDS Station per Android 2.2.0
releases.body:
## Novità per gli amministratori

- **Cambia nome utente**: dalla lista utenti. L'utente viene disconnesso e accede di nuovo con il nuovo nome; salvataggi, console e amici restano invariati.
- **Salvataggi di un giocatore**: per ogni gioco puoi scaricare il salvataggio del giocatore oppure sostituirlo (o crearlo) con un file .sav, anche esportato da DeSmuME o da un altro emulatore. Prima di caricare viene chiesta conferma, con un avviso se le dimensioni non corrispondono al salvataggio attuale. La versione sostituita resta nella cronologia del server, e se il giocatore stava giocando su quella vecchia all'uscita gli viene chiesto quale tenere.

## Altre modifiche

- I dati locali (ROM in cache, copie dei salvataggi, stati salvati) sono legati all'account e non più al nome utente: dopo un cambio di nome restano al loro posto. Alla prima apertura vengono spostati automaticamente.

## Requisiti

Server [nds-server-emulator-fastapi](https://github.com/federico-castellani/nds-server-emulator-fastapi) aggiornato (commit `7d2701c`). Con un server precedente l'app funziona, ma le nuove funzioni di amministrazione non sono disponibili.

- Il controllo degli aggiornamenti parte all'avvio anche se il server non è raggiungibile, e l'avviso compare anche nella schermata di accesso.

releases.name: NDS Station per Android 2.1.0
releases.body:
## Novità

- **Aggiornamenti dall'app**: NDS Station controlla da solo se c'è una nuova versione (all'avvio, oppure da Impostazioni → Aggiornamenti), scarica l'APK, lo verifica e lo installa. Android chiede conferma; partite, salvataggi e impostazioni restano. La prima volta va consentita l'installazione di app da NDS Station.
- **Audio in avanti veloce**: il suono non si spegne più. Resta al tono originale (voci ed effetti naturali, la musica avanza a salti) a volume un po' più basso. In Impostazioni → Audio puoi scegliere anche "Accelerato" o "Muto".

## Installazione

Scarica `NDSStation-2.1.0.apk` sul telefono e aprilo. Si installa sopra la versione precedente senza perdere i dati. Dalle prossime versioni l'aggiornamento avverrà dall'app.

releases.name: NDS Station per Android 2.0.1
releases.body:
Prima versione per Android di NDS Station, con le stesse funzioni del client Windows 2.0.1.

## Funzioni

- Libreria del server con ricerca; ROM scaricate e tenute in cache.
- Emulatore melonDS con tasti virtuali su schermo, touch sullo schermo inferiore, controller fisici, pausa, avanti veloce e stati salvati.
- Salvataggi sincronizzati con il server; se un altro dispositivo ha salvato un progresso più recente, all'uscita scegli se sovrascriverlo.
- Stessa identità di console di PC e telefono: la lista amici Nintendo WFC resta valida.
- Lotte e scambi online tramite Nintendo WFC, anche tra giocatori sulla stessa rete di casa.
- Pannello di amministrazione.

## Requisiti

- Android 8.0 o superiore (arm64 o x86_64).
- Server [nds-server-emulator-fastapi](https://github.com/federico-castellani/nds-server-emulator-fastapi) aggiornato.

## Installazione

Scarica `NDSStation-2.0.1.apk` sul telefono e aprilo (va consentita l'installazione da origini sconosciute). L'APK è firmato con una chiave di sviluppo: per aggiornarlo in futuro usa sempre gli APK di queste release.
